nodes.description: Address stored as the contract owner; used as an access-control gate and as a whitelist bypass in ensure().
Public mapping tracking token balances, mutated by transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount, read and decremented in transferFrom and written in approve.
Private mapping counting sales per address; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Private mapping whitelist read in ensure() that bypasses sale conditions.
Minimum sale value configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Maximum sale value configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Sale count threshold configured by init() and checked in condition().
Address set by setTradeAddress and treated as a trusted sender in ensure().
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance spender and ownership assignment.
Public transfer function that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Public transfer implementation; mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
Internal whitelist check that bypasses all sale restrictions for owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale entries.
Public allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale constraints on transfers.
Public function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Arbitrary low-level delegatecall in delegate() giving external code full control of the contract context.
Unchecked additions/subtractions/multiplications on balances and sale amounts (balanceOf[_from] -= _value, total = _value * _tos.length).
Parameter _from of transferFrom, used as the source balance key and as the key to the ensure() whitelist.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, used as destination balance key and passed to ensure().
Parameter _value of transferFrom, validated by ensure/condition and applied to balances and allowance.
Local variable _UNI holding the computed Uniswap pair address, used as a trusted-sender bypass in ensure().
Parameter _tos of batchSend, an arbitrary-length address array controlled by the owner.
Local variable total in batchSend computed as _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
Local loop counter i in batchSend used for iterating over _tos.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument when transfer() delegates to transferFrom().
transfer() internally calls transferFrom().
msg.sender is used as the spender in the allowance[_from][msg.sender] check allowing third-party spend.
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() grants an unconditional bypass when _from == owner, bypassing all sale restrictions.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist that bypasses condition() checks.
ensure() treats tradeAddress as a trusted sender and bypasses checks.
ensure() calls condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() reads contract balance state indirectly when evaluating sale conditions.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the _saleNum limit.
condition() compares _value against _minSale.
condition() compares _value against _maxSale.
condition() reads _saleNum as the per-address sale threshold.
Parameter _from supplies the source balance key in transferFrom().
Parameter _to supplies the destination balance key in transferFrom().
Parameter _value is the amount applied to allowance and balances in transferFrom().
Parameter _from is passed into ensure() for whitelist evaluation.
Parameter _to is passed into ensure() for whitelist evaluation.
Parameter _value is passed into ensure() and then condition().
transferFrom() mutates allowance, balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw unchecked -= and += operations.
_from indexes the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value subtraction.
_value is subtracted/added without SafeMath overflow protection.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without a SafeMath guard.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller address.
approve() writes the allowance mapping.
delegate() authorizes only msg.sender == owner before performing an arbitrary delegatecall.
delegate() executes an arbitrary user-supplied delegatecall, granting full control of contract storage.
The delegatecall transfers execution context to externally supplied code, which can re-enter or mutate state.
init() restricts execution to msg.sender == owner.
init() writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfer.
Parameter _tos supplies the recipient array iterated by batchSend().
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
The unchecked product total feeds balance deductions susceptible to overflow.
batchSend() mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
Loop counter i drives the recipient iteration in batchSend().
setTradeAddress() restricts execution to msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
setTradeAddress() reads owner to compare against msg.sender.
Local _UNI pair address is used by ensure() as a trusted sender bypass.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only consumed by transferFrom and ensure for balance and whitelist lookups, so it is normalized into the transferFrom function node.
_to is only used as the destination balance key inside transferFrom, so it collapses into the transferFrom function node.
_value is only consumed by transferFrom/ensure/condition to update balances and allowance, so it merges into transferFrom.
_UNI is a computed local only used inside ensure() as a whitelist address, so it is absorbed into the ensure function node.
_tos is only iterated inside batchSend, so it collapses into the batchSend function node.
total is a temporary arithmetic result used only within batchSend, so it merges into the batchSend function node.
i is a loop index used only inside batchSend, so it is normalized into the batchSend function node.
